name: Buns Out!
detailed_description:
Punch your friends, parkour through chaos, and laugh your buns off!

Buns Out! is a wild, third-person co-op platformer for up to 4 players! Run, jump, wall-run, and punch everything (and everyone) in your path as you explore zany levels packed with challenges, goofy minigames, and nonstop fun.

Whether you're climbing cliffs, smacking your pals into the void, or scrambling for collectibles in open sandbox stages, it’s always mayhem—and always hilarious. Work together or turn on each other in a co-op brawler and laugh your buns off while unlocking wacky outfits and powering through punch-filled gameplay.

Key Features

  • Local & online multiplayer for 1–4 players;

  • Wall-run, vault, and climb with parkour movement;

  • Slapstick combat with light, heavy, and dashing attacks;

  • Unlock and equip hats, shirts, and more;

  • Colorful cel-shaded visuals in a handcrafted world.

Game Modes

  • Challenge Zones: Open-ended levels full of climbing, jumping, brawling, and exploration. Beat all challenges to progress and uncover new areas;

  • Tournament Mode: Face off in a sequence of fast-paced minigames. Players compete to win a set number of rounds first to claim victory.

Team up or throw your friends off a ledge. Either way, in Buns Out!, it’s always a blast—and someone’s getting punched.

More screenshots, gameplay videos are coming soon. 
Follow on social media to stay tuned and wishlist the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2nd Gen / AMD Ryzen 3nd Gen
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2nd Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 2nd Gen
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
